<thought>To find the appropriate Wolff‑Kishner reduction template, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone functional group and forms an alkane. I’ll use a simple ketone SMILES (CC(=O)C) as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkane"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
